boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of North Dakota
boards.description: Ten named Grand Forks food destinations with publicly listed late operating hours; confirm service options before leaving campus.

cards.title: Roadhouse Cafe
cards.subtitle: 4720 Gateway Dr, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Head to the Simonson Travel Center location when you need a full meal at an unusual hour; its official site says it is open 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour café inside Simonson Travel Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Roadhouse Cafe states that it is located at 4720 Gateway Dr and is open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the café as open 24 hours every day; located inside Simonson Travel Center.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1301 S Washington St, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or dine-in option after an evening out; the location lists 3 a.m. closes most nights and 4 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A South Washington stop with especially late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this Grand Forks location's drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. daily except Friday and Saturday, when it lists 4 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; it also lists dine-in hours.

cards.title: Wendy’s on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1503 S Washington, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Plan for a late drive-thru or restaurant stop on South Washington; Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-thru service until 2 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. every day for 1503 S Washington.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 2 a.m. every day.

cards.title: McDonald’s on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1125 S Washington St, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru when the lobby has closed; the official listing shows drive-thru service through midnight every day and lobby service through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A South Washington drive-thru listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists drive-thru hours until midnight daily at 1125 S Washington St; restaurant lobby hours are listed until 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows drive-thru until 12 a.m. daily; lobby service is listed until 11 p.m.

cards.title: Domino’s on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 2705 S Washington, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this named South Washington store; its official location page currently shows service until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery option listed until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official page identifies its 2705 S Washington Grand Forks store and states it is open until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently states “Today Until 1:00 AM”; verify the day-specific closing time when ordering.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1418 S Washington St, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to check delivery or carryout for this South Washington restaurant, which is listed as open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A pizza delivery and carryout location listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's Grand Forks location page lists the 1418 S Washington St restaurant as open until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official location listing says the 1418 S Washington St restaurant is open until midnight.

cards.title: Culver’s on 32nd Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 3451 32nd Avenue South, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or Curdside pickup for the later window here; Culver’s lists those services through 11 p.m., after its 10 p.m. lobby close.
cards.short_summary: Drive-thru and Curdside service listed until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver's lists daily Curdside and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m. for its 3451 32nd Avenue South location.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists lobby and dine-in until 10 p.m.; Curdside and drive-thru are listed until 11 p.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery, 1305 S Columbia Road
cards.title: Perkins on South Columbia
cards.subtitle: 1305 S Columbia Road, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Set this up as a sit-down or takeout option before the 11 p.m. close; Perkins lists restaurant dining and bakery service at this address.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant-and-bakery option listed until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins lists its 1305 S Columbia Road Grand Forks restaurant hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours until 11 p.m. every day.

cards.title: Skies 322 at The Olive Ann
cards.subtitle: 322 Demers Avenue, downtown Grand Forks
cards.notes: Make this a downtown dinner plan rather than a last-minute dash: the restaurant lists Friday and Saturday dinner service through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A downtown hotel restaurant with midnight weekend dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Skies 322 lists dinner hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday at 322 Demers Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner 3 p.m.–12 a.m. Friday–Saturday; Sunday–Thursday dinner is listed until 11 p.m.

cards.title: Denny’s on 32nd Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 3770 32nd Avenue South, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Keep this 32nd Avenue South diner in mind for an all-hours meal; Grand Forks’ visitor bureau lists the location as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A diner listed as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Grand Forks lists the Denny's at 3770 32nd Avenue South as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The Grand Forks visitor bureau lists this Denny's as open 24 hours; confirm before traveling.
